evidence_card.sibling_feature_id: existing feature whose leaf_name matches, or empty
evidence_card.fan_in: other packages that reference this package's unique declarations
evidence_card.entry_count: own user-facing or process entries, using this repo's entry signals
evidence_card.consumer_ids: feature packages that reference this package
evidence_card.decl_sample: up to 8 declared names, not a file list

decision.target_id: module id to join or create
decision.evidence: one sentence citing fan-in, consumers, or leaf match
